entities.name: EAP-TLS based primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Mutual authentication procedure between UE and network using EAP-TLS method for primary authentication and key agreement in 5G system.

entities.name: EAP-request message
entities.description: EAP message sent from network to UE during EAP-TLS authentication procedure.

entities.name: EAP-success message
entities.description: EAP message indicating successful completion of EAP-TLS authentication.

entities.name: EAP-failure message
entities.description: EAP message indicating failure of EAP-TLS authentication.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REJECT message
entities.description: NAS message that may transport EAP-failure message when authentication fails.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: Next Generation Key Set Identifier used to identify security contexts.

entities.name: ABBA
entities.description: Anti-Bidding down Between Architectures parameter used in key derivation.

entities.name: KAUSF
entities.description: Authentication Server Function key derived from MSK or EMSK during EAP-TLS authentication.

entities.name: KSEAF
entities.description: SEAF key derived from KAUSF during authentication.

entities.name: KAMF
entities.description: AMF key derived from KSEAF and ABBA parameter.

entities.name: Partial native 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Temporary security context created during EAP-TLS authentication identified by ngKSI.

entities.name: Timer T3520
entities.description: Timer started by UE when server certificate is not accepted, stopped upon receiving EAP-request message.

entities.name: Timer T3247
entities.description: Timer started when AUTHENTICATION REJECT message is received without integrity protection.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: 5GMM state entered when authentication fails or AUTHENTICATION REJECT message is received.

entities.name: SNPN onboarding services condition
entities.description: Condition based on whether UE is registering/registered for onboarding services in SNPN.

relations.description: EAP-TLS authentication procedure involves exchange of EAP-request messages.
Successful completion of EAP-TLS authentication involves EAP-success message.
Failed EAP-TLS authentication involves EAP-failure message.
EAP-request message contains ngKSI value for security context identification.
EAP-request message contains ABBA parameter for key derivation.
EAP-success message contains ABBA parameter for key derivation.
SNPN onboarding condition determines whether KAUSF is derived from MSK or EMSK.
KAUSF is used to derive KSEAF during authentication.
KSEAF and ABBA are used to derive KAMF.
KAMF is stored in the partial native 5G NAS security context.
EAP-failure message may be transported in AUTHENTICATION REJECT message.
Receipt of AUTHENTICATION REJECT message causes UE to enter 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
AUTHENTICATION REJECT message without integrity protection starts timer T3247.
Receipt of EAP-request message stops timer T3520 if running.
Receipt of AUTHENTICATION REJECT message causes deletion of partial NAS security context.
